data.title: Hudson sticks with beaten Thai stars
data.description: Anthony Hudson intends to keep faith with the core of the squad that fell just short in the Fifa Asean Cup, as Thailand's head coach turns his attention to next year's Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia.

data.title: Saysunee gunning for trio of gold
data.description: Five-time Paralympic gold medallist Saysunee Jana will lead the Thai wheelchair fencing team at the 2026 Asian Para Games, while the coaching staff have identified China and South Korea as their key rivals in Aichi-Nagoya from Oct 18-24.

data.title: ONE Championship: Yu Yau Pui eyes Stamp Fairtex fight after finding herself again
data.description: Hong Kong’s Yu Yau Pui would welcome a fight with Thai star Stamp Fairtex as she looks to climb ONE Championship’s atomweight Muay Thai rankings with renewed self-belief after beating Britain’s Marie McManamon.

data.title: ONE Championship: Luke Lessei enters title picture as Carrillo eyes first defence
data.description: Luke Lessei has strengthened his case to challenge Nico Carrillo in his first defence of the undisputed featherweight Muay Thai title, with back-to-back wins arriving as the ONE Championship king targets December.

data.title: Verstappen revival to be put to the test in steamy Singapore
data.description: SINGAPORE - Max Verstappen's resurgence in Malaysia will be put to the test just 300 kilometres south at the Singapore Grand Prix this weekend, where the Red Bull driver may need to overcome the elements and his own poor record at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

data.title: Aichi governor upset as Thai teqball team complain about food at Asian Games
data.description: Hideaki Ōmura, governor of Aichi Prefecture, has said he is displeased that Thailand's national teqball team posted complaints online about the small food portions at the 2026 Asian Games, suggesting they did it to attract views and that he would rather they did not return.

data.title: Messi signs off in tears after one last Argentina master class
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — Lionel ⁠Messi delivered one ⁠last master class in ​blue and white on Tuesday as Argentina's captain brought the curtain down on his extraordinary 21-year international career by ​scoring one goal and setting up two others ‌in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.

data.title: Oosterhuis: A giant of game with a sweet 2-iron
data.description: It was a filthy day with non-stop rain pounding the Hilversumsche course and I found myself sitting on a clubhouse couch next to Peter Oosterhuis. Back in 1974, Peter was the man of the moment and was consistently winning tournaments over a ten-year period. We chatted about this and that and he mentioned he was hoping to go out and play, as he was only one shot back. All the other players, who were not in contention, didn't want to go out in the Dutch monsoon. However, the tournament ultimately was reduced to just three rounds and Brian Barnes was declared the winner.

data.title: Thunder Castle open  Shopee Cup defence
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United will kick off their Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup campaign in Group A, taking on Indonesia's Borneo Samarinda on Wednesday.

data.title: Ten-man Thailand fall short
data.description: Thailand came within one penalty of a remarkable triumph in Jakarta on Monday night as Emil Audero saved Nattapong Sayriya's spot-kick to give Indonesia a 4-2 shootout victory and the inaugural Fifa Asean Cup.

data.title: Powerlifter Kamolpan eyes medal
data.description: Powerlifter Kamolpan Kraratpet, Thailand's sole medallist in the discipline, at the last Asian Para Games, will lead a six-strong team to Japan this month in search of a place on the podium again.

data.title: Ronaldo opens door for Portugal return, apologises for walkout
data.description: BARCELONA - Cristiano Ronaldo opened the door for a return to the Portuguese national team on Tuesday and apologised for his walkout, while also accusing coach Jorge Jesus of twice breaking his word.

data.title: End of an era as Messi prepares to hang up Argentina boots
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Lionel Messi will pull on Argentina's sky blue-and-white jersey for the last time on Tuesday and enjoy an emotional farewell in front of his adoring fans in a stadium with a name to match his legacy: Monumental.

data.title: NHL record-breaker Ovechkin says current season will be his last
data.description: WASHINGTON — NHL all-time scoring leader Alex Ovechkin said Monday that the current season will be his last in the North American ice hockey league.

data.title: France roar back in Nations League as Italy beat Turkey
data.description: PARIS - Michael Olise starred as France stormed back from behind to thrash Belgium 4-1 in the Uefa Nations League on Monday, while Italy continued their resurgence with victory over Turkey.

data.title: Rungroj to spearhead Thai charge
data.description: The man who gave Thailand its first Paralympic table tennis gold is hungry for more.

data.title: Jeeno Thitikul secures 4th win this season at Lotte Championship
data.description: Jeeno Thitikul didn't ​let a late ⁠double bogey block ⁠her path to a fourth ​LPGA Tour win this year, responding with birdies on the final two holes to secure the Lotte Championship on Sunday ​in Honolulu.

data.title: Portugal move into Nations League knockout stage, Germany held
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Portugal became the first team to reach the quarter-finals of the Nations League when they beat Norway 2-1 on Sunday, but Jurgen Klopp's Germany were frustrated by Greece.

data.title: 'Gambler' Hudson ready to roll the dice once again
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson, pressed over his rotation policy, says he would make the same gamble again as his men face hosts Indonesia in tonight's inaugural Fifa Asean Cup final.

data.title: Cyclists turn Nagoya blank into fuel for Olympic push
data.description: Thailand's cyclists leave the Asian Games in Nagoya without a medal, but with a sharper sense of what it will take to reach the 2028 Olympics, and with enough ranking points banked to keep realistic hopes alive on road, track and BMX.

data.title: Eighteen gold, and a record away haul
data.description: Thailand arrived in Nagoya with a target of 14 gold medals. They left with 18, and a place in the record books.

data.title: Israel wear black armbands in Ireland tie over Hamas attack
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel's national football team wore black armbands in their Nations League clash against Ireland on Sunday to commemorate the victims of Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack, after Irish players wore them to protest the war in Gaza.

data.title: Teen titans shine in chaotic Games
data.description: NAGOYA: The 20th Asian Games closed yesterday after a rocky fortnight lit up by youthful brilliance in the sporting arenas but tempered by ‌logistical dysfunction and subdued public interest.

data.title: 10 fans injured when car ploughs into NRL final crowd in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY -  A car crashed into a crowd of rugby league supporters in the eastern Australian city of Newcastle on Satureday, injuring ten people, three of them children, local officials said.

data.title: South Korean flag glitch sees Asian Games end on sour note
data.description: TOYOTA CITY, Japan - South Korea's Asian Games football captain called it "disappointing" after the country's flag appeared to get stuck during the victory ceremony following their win over hosts Japan.

data.title: Wake-up call! Forward Kristensen's double rocks rotated Thailand
data.description: Thailand's preparations for the Fifa Asean Cup final suffered a jolt on Friday night, when a heavily rotated side lost 2-1 to the Philippines in their final Group B fixture at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung.

data.title: Another slice of history for teen Thai skater Hiro
data.description: Hiro Kaewtathip made history again by winning Thailand's first-ever gold medal at the ISU Figure Skating Junior Grand Prix.

data.title: Star Puripol crowned the Asiad MVP
data.description: Star sprinter Puripol Boonson has been selected by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) as the Most Valuable Player (MVP) of the 20th Asian Games after delivering a spectacular performance on the track in Japan.

data.title: Memorable Thai performance yields 18 gold medals
data.description: Taekwondo star Banlung Tubtimdang, sailor Pinchanok Klaysomboon and jiu-jitsu fighter Orapa Senatham each stood atop the podium on Saturday, powering Thailand’s gold medal haul to 18 on the penultimate day of the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.
